verdicts.reason: A shrinks the RSVP CTA to a pill the same size as the three badges and lines them up in one row, so the call to action gets lost. It also breaks the headline over two lines and squeezes the italic subhead into a narrow, cramped column. The logo is mangled ('SOLST CE'), the legal text is jammed into the right corner, and the columns don't line up. B has a clear left-to-right order: headline block, then date/badges/a large RSVP button, then the product in its circle. Its flaws are a tiny, illegible logo, a missing-asset placeholder that runs off the bottom-right corner, and a sun circle cropped hard at the right edge.
